svg.aria-label: A rough example, a tip, built from the numbers on this screen, drawn with goats. 10 nannies. Up to 40 percent have no kid in a year, so about 6 kids. 40 to 60 percent of kids die in their first winter, so about 3 live. Goats refill a range slowly, 85 percent. Leave the nanny.
